why: branches are drawn, not listed: a column of names cannot say which one is checked out or how far each has moved
the branch you are on is first and marked, so you never search the list for the one row you already knew
the header the view draws across the top rides on the first row: without it there is no repo name and no warning that a switch could be refused
picking a branch switches to it. Copying its name is not what somebody typed branch: for
a switch is never forced. git refuses to overwrite uncommitted work and the refusal is reported, which is the confirmation
with work in the tree, stashing first is offered by name rather than done for you: a switch that quietly stashed is a switch that lost your work somewhere you did not look
divergence is two numbers the view can weight, not the sentence git prints. %(upstream:track) reads 'ahead 2, behind 1' and no layout can draw that
how far a branch is from the trunk is the reason to leave it alone, and it is measured against a trunk that exists rather than a guess at main
a word after the repo filters the branches, so branch:omacast-fixture login is one row and not a list to read
a filter that matches no branch answers nothing rather than falling back to every branch
